LEGAL NOTICE UNDER SECTION 138 OF THE NEGOTIABLE INSTRUMENTS ACT, 1881

Date: 23 October 2026

To,
Mr. Rahul Sharma,
Flat 4B, Green Park Society,
Pune 411045

Under instructions from our client, ABC Finance Ltd., we serve you the following notice.

1. You had issued cheque bearing No. 123456 dated 08 October 2026 for Rs. 1,85,000 drawn on State Bank of India, FC Road Branch, Pune, in favour of our client towards repayment of a business loan.

2. The said cheque was presented for payment on 15 October 2026 and was returned unpaid on 17 October 2026 with the bank remark "insufficient funds". A copy of the cheque return memo is enclosed.

3. Despite repeated requests, you have failed and neglected to pay the said amount of Rs. 1,85,000.

4. You are hereby called upon to pay the said amount of Rs. 1,85,000 within 15 days of receipt of this notice, failing which our client shall be constrained to initiate criminal proceedings against you under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, entirely at your risk as to costs and consequences.

Yours faithfully,
P. R. Deshmukh
Advocate for ABC Finance Ltd.
